summary: Dataset, DFM, and Result Selection pages now avoid repeated network-drive cache and header checks while loading.
details: Cached pages no longer wait for forced origin and development header refreshes before starting.
Advisory cache prechecks use stored file metadata instead of rereading full CSV contents; the authoritative load still verifies exact content before reuse.
Result Selection keeps indexed period lengths and sends one engine request only when a different length is actually required.

Background cache loads no longer synchronously rebuild the full dataset index or recalculate unrelated dependents; requested calculated chains validate exact precedent contents and refresh upstream-first on demand.

Calculated outputs retain the exact dataset format, instance, and DFM method source so a refresh cannot select an older or ambiguous cache variant, while saved DFM paths relocate safely to the current project root.
A Clear Cache request queued behind an active load keeps its refresh intent.
